title: Diana Essential Body & Hair Care
description: A Diana shower-gel packaging collection, presented through eight supplied bottle mockups. Fragrance-specific colours and imagery sit within a repeated label structure.
challenge: Keep eight fragrance variants part of one recognizable product family.
solution: The oval Diana mark and a consistent information hierarchy connect the labels, while colour, image and fragrance naming distinguish each bottle.
results: Eight supplied shower-gel bottle presentations. These are packaging mockups, not a claim of manufactured products or measured sales.
